pass: Gives blunt, direct advice that names a clear choice for him, the way an adult guides a younger person. Not vague comfort, not cold or dismissive, no mocking his grief.

earlier: Corin served Lise's family as a butler. When her parents were killed, he was turned into a vampire so he could protect the girl.
Nyra can read what people feel. Corin is torn between grief and duty.

dialogue.spoken: Lady Nyra... I don't know if I should keep serving the young lady. Every time I look at her, I see her parents die. What should I do?
